We’re giving it an A+ for overachieving seeing as it helps hydrate, plump, colour and shine in just one swipe… and it’s got glowing reviews too - 97% loved it that much, they would recommend it to a friend*.. Why you’ll love it: • Treats: Helps hydrate your lips from the inside out, and makes it feel deeply moisturised, both instantly and over time**. • Perfects: Lips looks smoother and fuller, with a healthy-looking glow and luxuriously glossy finish. • Protects: Helps protect against future dryness*** by strengthening the moisture barrier and shielding against UVA/UVB with SPF 20.. *Based on consumer study with 120 participants **After 4 weeks of continued use. Based on clinical efficacy study with 21 participants ***With continued use. Based on a clinical efficacy study. How to use it: Dial up the definition by lining your lips with one of our lip liners before you apply your gloss. . Swipe the gloss onto your lips or over your favourite lipstick shades for a more pigmented look.. Pop it into your favourite bags and purses for touch-ups on the go..

listings.rawTitle: Ultra Colour Bronzing Pearls Rosy Bronze
listings.description: All you need to know: . We’re about to turn your glow-up waaaaaay up with our radiant Ultra Colour Bronzing Pearls. These multi-dimensional bronzing pearls help you get your most gorgeous glow on, no sun required.. With three toning shades of shimmering pearls in every pot, you'll be basking in a warm sun-kissed glow and flattering finish that still looks oh. so. Natural. Our iconic bronzing pearls have been loved since 1996, so isn't it time you discovered them?. Treat yourself to this make-up bag must-have and rise to radiance with colours that come alive.. . . Why you’ll love it: . • Ultra dimensional glow: Triple-shade pearls infused with iridescent, light-reflecting pigments blend beautifully for a multi-dimensional sun-kissed glow.. • Ultra effortless: Just swirl, tap, and sweep to instantly enhance your complexion with natural-looking radiance and a flush of colour.. • Ultra iconic: Curated multi-shade range to suit a range of complexions - no wonder it’s our No.1 best-selling cheek make-up must-have*.. . *Based on 2024 Sales data for Avon International. . . How to use it: . Slide our All Over Face Brush out of your make-up brushes set for an all-over glow; or choose the Angled Blush Brush for more precise colour placement.. Swirl your brush into the pot, tap off any excess and sweep over cheeks, the bridge or your nose, and forehead: wherever the sun naturally catches your face.. . Get your hands on our Ultra Colour Blush Pearls - it’ll lure you in with its faux-flush!.

listings.rawTitle: Ultra Colour Kohl Eyeliner Pencil True Black
listings.description: All you need to know: Creating the perfect smokey eye couldn’t be easier with Ultra Colour Kohl Eyeliner Pencil. This is the super-soft kohl formula for ultra smooth application around your eyes, and along your waterline.. Line and define with ease, with full colour application in one line. Use the built-in smudging tool to smoke the easy-blend liner out to create a sultry, smokey eye you’ll love.. This soft kohl eyeliner contains Vitamin E and is suitable for people with sensitive eyes and contact lens wearers. Use Avon’s pencil sharpener to keep it on point.. No make-up bag is complete without a creamy kohl eyeliner, and with nine smoking shades to choose from, get ready to see the colours come alive.. Why you’ll love it: Ultra impact: Choose a dramatic line, or smudge to a smokey look, however you feel today. Ultra easy: Use the smudging tool on the base to smoke out for a sultry smokey eye in seconds. Ultra smooth: The super-soft kohl formula gives smooth application around your eyes and along your waterline.. How to use it: Go bold: Choose your shade and line along top lashes and your waterline for ultra drama.. Smoke it out: Line eyes and smoke out with the built-in smudging tool.. Brighten up with Nude: Line your waterline with the Brightening Nude shade to really make your eyes pop!. What’s in: Ultra smokey eyes made easy with kohl pencil, even if you wear contact lenses... What’s out: Limiting yourself to black smokey eyes, thanks to the wide shade range..

listings.rawTitle: Advance Techniques Expert Reviving Bond Repair Conditioner - 250ml
listings.description: All you need to know: Get your strongest, smoothest hair yet with Advance Techniques Expert Reviving Bond Repair Conditioner.. Formulated with bond-building Fiberfusion technology and Arginine amino acid - Advance Techniques Expert regime helps to instantly repair broken inner hair bonds with proteins - from the first wash.*. It also helps to reduce 3x hair breakage* while boosting strength and shine.. Get yourself the expert hair care you need… from the comfort of your home.. 250ml. Why you’ll love it: • It actively repairs damaged hair, giving you expert hair care at home. • You'll see instant results from the first wash. • Your hair will look twice as shiny and up to 90% smoother*!. What’s in: Fiberfusion technology to help repair damaged inner hair bonds.. What’s out: Spending hours at the salon to fix your hair.. How to use it: Cleanse and prepare Start by massaging Advance Techniques Expert Reviving Bond Repair Shampoo into wet hair - rinse thoroughly. Detangle and hydrate Apply the hair conditioner to your mid-lengths and ends - leave it on for three minutes before rinsing. Repair and rebuild For best results, finish with Advance Techniques Expert Reviving Bond Repair Deep Treatment - let it get to work for five minutes before rinsing.. *When compared to the hair treated with shampoo, without conditioning agent, and after using the full routine (shampoo, conditioner and treatment).

listings.rawTitle: Senses Lemon Burst Shower Gel 720ml

Why you’ll love it: • Enriched with natural extracts • Contains vitamin E, vitamin B5 & electrolytes • Recyclable packaging . How to use it: Lather up in the shower and get ready to burst into action thanks to its zesty scent..

Musk Rain Eau de Toilette - 75ml
Incandessence Eau de Parfum - 30 ml
listings.description: All you need to know: Filled with a glowing mix of bergamot, rose and teakwood - this luminous floral perfume develops throughout the day and keeps you sensationally scented while you rock your holiday best!. Is this the best perfume that brings the festive flare? We definitely think so.. 30 ml. Scent type: A fragrance that illuminates you with floral accords.. Key notes: Top notes: Bergamot. Middle notes: Rose. Bottom notes: Teakwood.. Why you’ll love it: • This sparkling perfume for women will have you dazzling others from the very first whiff. • It leaves you with an aura of warmness that’s simply captivating. • It comes in a gorgeous box, making gifting for you so much easier.. Maybe add some of our stud earrings to your gift for the perfect finishing touch..

listings.rawTitle: Full Speed Sky Jump Deodorising Body Spray - 150ml
listings.description: All you need to know: Want to experience the liberating scentsation of free-falling? Take a leap with Full Speed Sky Jump Deodorising Body Spray and feel the rush before the jump.. Our 1st ever scent imagined whilst skydiving - this woody citrus perfumed deodorant gives you effective odour control while plunging through your senses with its spicy pepper rush and Blue Sky blend of salty air and tiny ice oxygen crystals, before parachuting toward a driftwood landing.. This fragrance is so exhilarating… it’ll have you falling, your spine spinning, and your senses punching through the clouds as you glide out of your comfort zone.. 150ml. Scent type: A thrilling woody citrus fragrance that helps you free-fall into your best life, at terminal velocity.. Key notes: Top notes: White Grapefruit, Peppermint, Ginger. Middle notes: Blue Sky Blend, Pink and Black Peppers, Violet Leaves. Bottom notes: Orris Root, Patchouli, Driftwood.. Why you’ll love it: • This liberating scent was captured by master perfumer, David Apel, in free fall! • It’s an energising scent that helps you experience the exhilarating sensation of living your best life. • It gives you 24-hour deodorant protection and is suitable for everyday use.. How to use it: Spray it all over: After showering, liberally spray it all over your body (minus your face, of course!). Wear it wherever: This body spray is perfect for work and post-work sessions too. Just spray and go. Get it all: Get the matching Hair & Body Wash, Roll-On Anti-Perspirant Deodorant and Eau de Toilette to intensify your scent… or create your own perfume gift set and gift it to family and friends..

listings.rawTitle: Power Stay 16-Hour Creamy Vinyl Liquid Lip Colour Rose Rule
listings.description: All you need to know: Into the brilliantly shiny, supremely creamy, incredibly longwearing vinyl effect that’s also extremely hydrating? (Seriously, who isn’t?!) Say hi to Power Stay 16-Hour Creamy Vinyl Liquid Lip Colour.. With Colour Lock Technology - this life-proof, longwear liquid lipstick is serving up high shine, high impact, full coverage vinyl colour that stays locked on your lips for 16 hours*.. The best bits? It sets quickly; keeps your lips hydrated for 16 hours**(we’ve proved it #JustSaying); and won’t smudge, transfer or fade, so when the day goes by, your vibrant shine stays.. Get ready to radiate… because this make-up bag must-have is bringing the confidence with its brilliant colour and hydration.. Why you’ll love it: • Stays put: Creamy, waterproof, brilliant vinyl colour stays locked and looking freshly-applied for 16 hours*. • Stays brilliant: Don’t just take us at our word. 8/10 who tried it said it has a luxurious finish on their lips*. • Stays comfortable: Enriched with jojoba, olive and pomegranate oils. It also feels lightweight and keeps lips moisturised for 16 hours**. . What’s in: Dancing to the vinyl beat for 16 hours* straight.. What’s out: Liquid lipsticks that fail to keep up with your day.. How to use it: Swipe it as is: Shelve your lip liner because this long-lasting liquid lipstick is serving crisp definition and a sculpted look, thanks to its precision applicator. Don’t forget to let it set. Play to your own tune: Grab a few lipstick shades (every make-up kit demands a host of hues, okay) and try out an ombré look. Remove with ease: Wondering how to remove such a long-lasting liquid lipstick? Just soak a cotton pad with an oil-based makeup remover and wipe it off with ease.. *Based on a consumer study with 120 participants **Based on Clinical Efficacy Study" .

listings.rawTitle: Ultra Colour Bronzing Powder Sun Kissed
listings.description: All you need to know:. Think you need rays for days for a sun-kissed look... or a make-up artist's touch to nail the brontoured trend? Nope! Meet Ultra Colour Bronzing Powder - our buildable bronze that does it all.. This ultra versatile, buildable and blendable, silky smooth bronzer is the best make-up for your beauty routine to bring natural warmth to your skin, and to chisel and sculpt your features too!. Its secret? A formula with Ultra Colour HD Pigment Technology that brings a sun-kissed effect to your unique skin tone; as well as keeps your skin looking beautifully bronzed.. It’s also got a new plastic-free cardboard compact* so you can look good and do good too.. Treat yourself to this make-up bag must-have and step out with colours that come alive.. Why you’ll love it:. • Ultra effect: Use it to create a warm sun-kissed look, every season; or to sculpt and brontour your features.. • Ultra colour: Choose from 4 soft-matte shades, designed to add a sun-kissed effect to fair and deep skin tones.. • Ultra bronze: Gives you a beautifully ultra bronzed look you can’t help but love.. *Excluding removable and reusable elastic band. What’s in:. A kissed-by-the-sun bronze, every season.. What’s out:. Settling for anything less than beautifully bronzed.. How to use it:. Put in the prep: Start with a flawless canvas by using Ultra Match Foundation first and then setting with the Pressed Powder.. Go for golden: Lightly dab our All Over Face Brush into the bronzer powder and gently buff over where the sun naturally hits your face… think nose, chin, cheekbones and temples.. Brontour like a beaut: Using our new Contour Brush (another must for your make-up brushes set), blend the powder along your hairline, under your cheekbones and along your nose and jawline..

listings.rawTitle: Avon Care Intimate Calming Delicate Feminine Wash - 250ml
listings.description: About me: . Feel clean and confident whatever your day brings with our Calming Delicate Feminine Wash. It’s formulated to help control intimate feminine odour and give you all-day freshness, even during your period or when you’re working out. Dermatologically and gynecologically tested, the pH-balanced formula is suitable for sensitive skin too.. DID YOU KNOW? Using harsh shower gel on your intimate area could cause irritation and discomfort. Avon Care Intimate is gentle, pH balanced and specially designed for feminine hygiene, to help keep you feeling fresh and confident, all day.. Product specification: . • Intimate feminine wash. • With chamomile extract, witch hazel extract and vitamin E. • pH balanced, gynaecologically tested and fragrance free. • Size: 250ml.. How to use me: . Pour a small amount onto the palm of your hand or wash cloth. Apply to your vulval skin, lather and rinse thoroughly. For external use only..

listings.rawTitle: Ultra Eyeshadow Palette Aurora
listings.description: All you need to know: . Celebrate your creativity with these new shadows that are slaying the eye game, one shade at a time: the Ultra Eyeshadow Palettes. . From subtle everyday celebrations with friends, to creative looks on a girls’ night out, to bold party looks, we’ve got you. . These intensely pigmented palettes give you 9 high-impact colours in 4 fabulous finishes for ultra flexibility: buttery mattes, soft pearls, intense metallics and glowing glitters. And of course, they’re ultra smooth and ultra blendable, for all skin tones with no fall-out or creases.. With two stunning colour palettes to choose from; Aurora and Night Sky, will you create a subtle, glam, or bold eyeshadow look to express your creativity?. . Why you’ll love it: . • It’s ultra easy: apply with your fingers or a brush to build and blend without making a mess.. • It’s ultra versatile: allows you to create infinite looks that make all eye colours and skin tones pop.. What’s in:. Intensely pigmented powders for high-impact, ultra popping colour.. What’s out:. One-dimensional shadows that do nothing for your eyes.. . How to use it: . Elevate your eyes. Swipe a warm, subtle shade across your lid for a simple look to make your eyes pop.. Mix it up. Blend the matte, pearl, metallic and glitter shades for an ultra eye-catching, statement look.. Choose your tool. Use your fingers or our Eyeshadow Duo Brush for a seamless blend..

listings.rawTitle: Celebrate Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: All you need to know: . Ever stopped to wonder what’s the driving force that gets us through all of life’s ups and downs? ?It’s love… and it’s worth celebrating… every day… and in every form.. Cue Celebrate Eau de Parfum - a sparkling and joyful white floral curation of signature neroli blossoms and exotic Tiare Tahiti flowers… the French Polynesian symbol of romance, harmony and peace.. When words fail to convey what your heart wants to say, let this perfume from the Today Tomorrow Always collection do the talking.. Just wrap it, gift it, and mark it ‘scent with love’.. 50ml. Scent type: A white floral scent that reminds you to celebrate love every day.. Key notes:. Top notes: Lemon Essence, Muguet, Neroli.. Middle notes: Tuberose NP, Tiare Tahiti NP, Orange Flower Petals.. Bottom notes: Benzoin, American Cedarwood, Ambrettolide.. Why you’ll love it: . • This limited edition floral fragrance helps you celebrate love every day.. • It’s created by Master Perfumer Olivier Cresp in honour of Today Tomorrow Always’ 20-year anniversary.. • It’s the perfect present for loved ones and will definitely get their hugs of appreciation and stamp of approval.. How to use it: . Spritz it on. Spritz it on your wrists and neck to diffuse the scent more quickly. Don’t rub it in, doing so will make it fade faster.. Gift it out. This perfume makes the perfect Christmas gift so slip it under the tree or inside a loved one’s festive stocking. It also makes a great birthday and anniversary pressie too.. Collect them all. Like this scent? Get the other perfumes in the Today Tomorrow Always collection to symbolise every stage of your love story..

listings.rawTitle: Ultra Colour Liquid Highlighter Platinum Bronze
listings.description: All you need to know: . Ready to get your glow on and celebrate radiating with confidence? We’ve got just what you need - our Ultra Colour Liquid Highlighter.. Part of our limited edition Celebrate You collection, this beautifully blendable liquid highlighter lights up your look with a halo of ultra glistening shades, wherever you want to glow.. This is the ultra upgrade your make-up kit needs to deliver glow on demand so get it now and ooze sheer confidence.. It also makes the perfect stocking filler. #JustSaying. Why you’ll love it: . • Ultra radiance: Adds a glistening glow to your celebration look.. • Ultra versatile: Can be used on your face and body.. • Ultra creative: Choose between subtle Rose Gold or glam Platinum Bronze, or get creative with both.. What’s in:. A gorgeous glow that glistens in the light.. What’s out:. Flat, lifeless make-up looks, with zero personality.. How to use it: . Illuminate your base. Dab on some liquid foundation and then your highlighter for a glowing finish.. Highlight your features. Tap over cheekbones, Cupid’s bow, the tip of your nose, and brow bones - blend well to highlight.. Go lower. Don’t stop at your face: add highlights to your collarbone, chest and shoulders, and even your legs - wherever there’s skin on show, you can make it shimmer!.

listings.rawTitle: Attraction Closer for Him Eau de Toilette - 75ml
listings.description: All you need to know: . Set your senses dancing with Attraction Closer for Him Eau de Toilette and lose yourself in the moment when two souls move together in perfect sync, hearts beat together, and bodies move in harmony.. Inspired by the passion, allure and magnetism of a sensual dance - this oriental woody spicy scent features a skin-to-skin accord of creamy woods, velvet musks and sweet ambers that captures the warmth of physical touch.. It’s also got notes of invigorating pear, spicy pink peppercorn, and tonka beans that gets your senses moving.. It’s time to let your body do the talking and let the rhythm pull you closer.. 75ml. Scent type: An oriental woody spicy fragrance with an irresistible skin-to-skin accord that resonates with sensuality.. Key notes:. Top notes: Crisp Apple, Juicy Pear, Pink Peppercorn CO2 Orpur™.. Middle notes: Aromatic Shot Osmasylk Natsublim™, Leather Accord.. Bottom notes: Skin-to-Skin Accord, Vetiver des Sables India Orpur™, Tonka Beans Absolute Venezuela.. Why you’ll love it: . • This mesmerising symphony of scents is exactly what you need to get your heart racing.. • The shared skin-to-skin essence charges the atmosphere with warmth and sensuality.. • One whiff of this fragrance is all it takes to feel the chemistry of magnetic attraction.. How to use it: . Time it right. Spritz this men’s perfume onto your pulse points before things get heated.. Tease their senses. Spray it at least 3-5 inches away from your skin so it’s not too overpowering.. Spread the love. Treat your significant other to Attraction Closer for Her Eau de Parfum. You both will enjoy it..

listings.rawTitle: Mineral Loose Powder 1 - Light
listings.description: All you need to know: . Why settle for a powder that just sets your base, when you can choose a mineral powder that cares as it covers. Try the buildable, blendable, perfecting Mineral Loose Powder that makes your skin look more radiant, even after you take it off*.. Expertly formulated with 100% naturally derived mineral pigments plus essential nutrients for more radiant-looking skin, this is the mineral powder that treats you well and boosts skin’s radiant look.. Available in 5 shades suitable for all skin tones, you can wear it alone, or as a finishing powder over your favourite 3-In-1 Serum Foundation.. . Why you’ll love it: . • PERFECTS: Gives skin a luminous, healthy glow with sheer-light buildable coverage that perfectly harmonises with skin for the most natural look.. • TREATS: After 1 week of use, skin looks more radiant, healthier and more even, even after you take it off*.. • PROTECTS: Formula with Zinc PCA and Calcium PCA to help to maintain skin's suppleness and to help to even skin tone**.. *After 1 week and with continued use. Based on Consumer Science Study with 167 participants. **Based on testing in skin cells. What’s in:. Formulated with 100% naturally derived mineral pigments and essential nutrients for naturally gorgeous radiance.. What’s out:. Harsh ingredients that mask your skin’s natural beauty or dry skin out.. . How to use it: . Shake it to make it. Shake a small amount of mineral powder into the lid.. Sweep and blend. Use our Kabuki Brush or All Over Face Brush to pick up the powder from the lid, tap off any excess and blend, starting from the centre of your face, working outwards.. Repeat for more coverage. Shake and blend more powder if needed, to build to your preferred coverage..

listings.rawTitle: Power Stay Liquid Lip Persistent Pink
listings.description: About me: . Over the sticky-lip feel you get from other liquid lip colours? Lock in your lip look and embrace your power to feel confident all day. It’s time to make room in your make-up bag for Power Stay Liquid Lip, the non-sticky, non-tacky colour that stays looking rich and freshly applied for up to 16 hours* thanks to Colour Lock Technology, which locks in your high-impact matte finish.. Think zero top-ups. No make-up checks. And plenty of time to take on all that life throws at you. The best part about this liquid lipstick? There’s zero compromise. Fast-drying, no smudging and super-comfortable thanks to a blend of moisturising pomegranate and olive oils for a non-sticky and non-tacky feel.. It’s a long-lasting lip colour done right! Finally.. Product Specification: . STAYS RICH: High impact matte finish colour that’s locked in for up to 16hrs.*. STAYS COMFORTABLE: Feels lightweight, non-sticky and non-tacky, with pomegranate extract and olive oil.. STAYS PUT: Dries fast in one precise swipe, without smudging or transferring.. How to use it:? . Line - Outline your lips with Avon Glimmerstick Lip Liner to emphasise your shape.. Swipe - Apply your lipstick within the lined area. Use the doe-foot applicator for precise, mess-free coverage, starting with your top lip and then moving to the bottom.. Wipe - When you’re ready to head to bed, just remove it with one of our oil-based cleansers.. *Product is transfer-proof, mask-proof and waterproof. Based on a consumer use study with 105 participants..

listings.description: About Me: . 3 days, 72-hours*, whichever way you look at it, this eyeliner has some serious staying power. listings.rawTitle: Power Stay Brow Tint Light Brown
listings.description: About Me: . Here to stay. Meet the semi-permanent†, waterproof brow tint that’s so flexible you can create any brow look you love. With the power to last up to 3 days* take fixing your brows every 5 minutes off the agenda and make room for… well, anything you like (except the washing, that can wait).. Product Specification: SEMI-PERMANENT† EFFECT Formula with more staying power than ever, lasts for up to 3 days* without smudging or fading. PRECISE DEFINITION Fine tip allows for easy application creating the lasting look you want.. How To Use Me: . The precision applicator is specially designed to provide even, hair-like strokes that fill in sparse areas. Use in short motions to mimic your natural hairs and fill to natural or bold – it’s your call. And, just in case you change your mind, it’s super-easy to remove with an oil-based remover.. *Lasts for up to 3 days. Based on a consumer science study with 101 participants. †Easy to remove with an oil-based make-up remover..

Meet our Advance Techniques Deeply Purifying Treatment Scrub that helps reduce excess oils by 30%,* so you don’t need to wash your hair as often. This exfoliating scrub works directly on the scalp and roots to reduce impurities, for a longer-lasting* ‘just washed’ effect without drying. Product specification: • Scalp and hair treatment scrub. • Infused with salicylic acid and kaolin clay. • Part of the Advance Techniques Deeply Purifying collection. • Size: 150ml. How to use me: Before shampooing apply onto damp hair and scalp. Massage into scalp, then rinse. Follow with Deeply Purifying Shampoo and Conditioner. *With continued use 3 to 4 times a week over 1 month. Applies to the Treatment Scrub only or when used with Deeply Purifying Shampoo and Conditioner.

listings.rawTitle: Advance Techniques Deeply Purifying Shampoo
listings.description: About me: Is your hair prone to oiliness? It gently cleanses your scalp and locks for hair that feels squeaky clean, silky and soft. Product specification: • Purifying shampoo for hair and scalp. • Infused with salicylic acid and kaolin clay. • Part of the Advance Techniques Deeply Purifying collection. • Size: 400ml. How to use me: Wet your hair and lather, then rinse and repeat if needed. For optimal results, follow with the Advance Techniques Deeply Purifying Conditioner.

listings.rawTitle: Anew HA Hydrate & Plump Serum - 30ml
listings.description: All you need to know: Embrace every expression with plumper-looking skin without the fillers. How? With Anew HA Hydrate & Plump Serum, of course.. A skincare beaut for instant hydration and a bounce-back effect - this face serum uses 3.5% Hyaluronic Acid complex to help attract and lock in moisture; whilst its tri-molecule formula delivers 180% more Hyaluronic Acid to deeper surface skin surface layers*.. The result: instant hydration, plumped-looking skin, and a reduction in the look of fine lines and wrinkles with continued use**.. Get in on all this plumping power. We’ve got a feeling you and your skin will be more than pleased.. 30ml. . You can now buy a serum refill tube for this serum! It’s budget-friendly and planet-friendly. . . Why you’ll love it: • This hydrating serum has been co-created with dermatologists and scientists… and is a must if you’ve got dry, dehydrated skin. • It’s infused with a high concentration of Hyaluronic Acid complex so you can enjoy unstoppable hydration. • The tri-molecule formula allows for deeper skin surface penetration.. *vs previous Anew HA 1.5% Serum formula. **Based on a 5-day consumer science study with 120 participants.. What’s in: Deeply hydrated, plumper-looking skin.. What’s out: Parched, dry skin that’s screaming out for moisture.. How to use it: Start with a face serum After cleansing and toning, dab a pea-sized amount of serum onto your face and neck until it’s fully absorbed.. Move to your moisturiser Follow with Anew HA Hydrate & Plump Water Cream and enjoy double the plumping power without the fillers.. Make it a routine Use this power pair every morning and night for best results..

listings.rawTitle: Anew Hydrate & Plump Concentrate Sample
listings.description: About me: Are you ready to experience next-level skin hydration? Anew Anti-Wrinkle Plumping Concentrate is formulated with 3.5% hyaluronic acid complex to intensely hydrate and lock in moisture for instantly plumped looking skin. Not only that but it retains water within the surface layers of skin to help reduce the look of fine lines and keep it feeling smooth and bouncy. Thanks to its 3 sizes of hyaluronic acid molecules, this skin-saving serum helps plump multiple surface layers of skin at once. Large hyaluronic acid works on the surface of the skin to provide an instant plumping effect. Medium hyaluronic acid penetrates the skin, where wrinkles begin to form. And small hyaluronic acid penetrates deepest for long-lasting hydration and plumpness. Product specification: • Skin concern: Dry and dehydrated skin • Formulated with 3.5% hyaluronic acid complex. • Allergy and clinically tested. • Size: 30ml. How to use me: Smooth one drop into cleansed face and neck in an upward and outward motion. Apply twice a day, morning, and evening.

listings.rawTitle: Essence Lemongrass & Coconut Hand Wash - 250ml
listings.description: About me: Who said bathroom essentials had to be boring? Upgrade your bathroom with our luxurious Lemongrass & Coconut collection... stunningly stylish and the perfect addition to any sink side in your home. listings.rawTitle: Clearskin Pore & Shine Control Purifying Charcoal Mask - 75ml
listings.description: All you need to know: . When your skin is shiny and your pores are extra visible, reach for our Clearskin Pore & Shine Control Purifying Charcoal Mask. . This purifying face mask is formulated with an effective blend of eucalyptus, witch hazel and charcoal extracts, plus salicylic acid and absorbent powders like clay. . It’s just the thing to reduce excess oil and remove pore-clogging dirt, purifying and mattifying the look of oily skin and leaving it feeling clean, fresh and balanced. . 75ml. Why you’ll love it: . • It helps reduce shine and visible pores, without drying out your skin. . • It will leave oily skin feeling fresh and looking visibly clean. . • It’s so easy to use - simply pop it onto clean skin and let it sit for 10 minutes.. What’s in:. Skin that feels squeaky clean.. What’s out:. A shiny T-zone!. How to use it: . Start with clean skin . Start by cleansing your skin. We love our Clearskin Pore & Shine Control Purifying Charcoal Jelly Cleanser for oily skin and visible pores.. Apply a light layer . Once your skin is cleansed, apply a thin layer of this mask to your face, and leave it to dry for 10-15 minutes. It will transform from black to light grey. . Allow to dry and rinse . Once it feels completely dry, rinse thoroughly with warm water and pat dry. Use it 2-3 times a week..

Now with Colour Lock Technology, this transfer-proof, buildable, satin-matte stain stays put for 10 hours*… so as the day goes by, the power stays.. . It also has a non-drying formula; a lightweight, comfy feel; and a precision applicator that fits the shape of your lips.. . The best bit? The plethora of lipstick shades! Trust us, it’s make-up bag must-have.. . . Why you’ll love it:​ . . • Stays put: Sheer tint, satin-matte effect won’t budge for 10 hours*.. . • Stays comfortable: Non-drying formula won’t dry out or crack your lips.. . • Stays rich: Bare lip feel with staying power… Amazing!. . . What’s in: . . Colour Lock Technology and a non-drying formula so you can enjoy colour with comfort for hours .. . What’s out: . . Lip stains that dry and crack your lips.. . . How to use it: . . Customise your shade: Go with one coat for a fresh flush, two for a natural hue, and three for a full-on satin-matte vibe.. . Exercise restraint: When it comes to lip stains, remember a little goes a long way.. . Strike a balance: Make your stunning lip pop by using one of our subtle eyeshadow shades on your lids.. . *Based on a consumer study with 110 participants. .

listings.rawTitle: Skin So Soft Original Dry Oil Spray Bonus Size - 250ml 250 ml
listings.description: About me: . . Our top-rated* body moisturiser is now available in a bonus size!. For long-lasting smooth, nourished skin, choose our Skin So Soft Original Dry Oil Spray. Suitable for normal to dry skin, it’s infused with jojoba oil to help lock in moisture, leaving your skin soft and smelling beautiful.. . Product specification: . . • Lightweight oil formula glides onto your skin with ease.. • Smooths your skin’s surface while providing essential moisture.. • Provides your skin with lasting softness.. • Formulated with skin-loving jojoba oil.. • Size: 250ml.. • Also available in 150ml and 100ml travel size. . . . How to use me: . . For instantly moisturised skin, spray this quick-drying formula generously over your skin after a bath or shower. It’s so easy to use!. Our Skin So Soft Dry Oil Spray is stored in a warehouse before it’s shipped to its new home and can sometimes solidify in colder temperatures. We recommend leaving your bottle at room temperature or placing it in a bowl of warm water for the oil to return to normal. This won’t affect the product in any way.. . *based on total Original Dry Oil Spray units sold for 100ml, 150ml and 250ml from 01.05.22 to 31.08.2022. . .

listings.rawTitle: Planet Spa Blissfully Nourishing Hand & Foot Mask - 100ml
listings.description: All you need to know: Hard-working hands and feet deserve a little TLC so pencil in some me-time (5 minutes is all we need) and treat yourself to Planet Spa Blissfully Nourishing Hand & Foot Mask.. It’s enriched with paraffin wax that helps remove dead skin cells and smooth skin; and African shea butter that’s been used for centuries to help moisturise, soften and protect skin.. Go on… treat yourself to the manicure and pedicure you need for nourished, smooth, soft and silky hands and feet without a greasy feel.. 100ml. Why you’ll love it: • Formulated with exfoliating and smoothing paraffin wax; and nourishing and softening shea butter. • Helps moisturise, soften and smooth your hands, feet and cuticles. • Saves you a trip to the spa because you can now get a pro-like manicure and pedicure at home.. How to use it: Layer it on Massage a thick layer onto your hands and feet, wrap them in a warm towel for 3-5 minutes, and then wipe it off.. Bolster your foot care regime If your feet need a little more attention, soak them in warm water for at least 10 minutes and then scrub with a foot file before applying the mask.. Finish off your mani and pedi Push back your cuticles, trim the excess cuticle skin, cut your nails, smooth the edges, paint your nails and you’re good to go. Ps. We’ve got all the tools you need to get it done..

How to use it: Freshen up on the go Pop it into your bag for a quick refresh at midday.. listings.rawTitle: Far Away Beyond Body Lotion - 125ml
listings.description: All you need to know: Looking for a body lotion with an intoxicating scent, head-turning potency and a luxurious, moisturised feel that goes beyond expectation? Meet our Far Away Beyond Body Lotion.. Filled with the same oriental gourmand scent of the matching Far Away Beyond Parfum - this body lotion is also infused with double-distilled upcycled Madagascan vanilla made of reused vanilla beans to reveal a superior, longer-lasting, salty-sweet facet of vanilla, opulent woods, and beautiful jasmine florals. . listings.description: All you need to know: Want to see firm, supple skin? The upgraded formula, backed by 20 years of collagen longevity research**, uses award-winning Protinol™, Phytol, and a new Firming Active to help future-proof your collagen reserves. After 1 day, your skin will feel firmer and more supple; and after 3 weeks, your skin will look regenerated and wrinkles visibly reduced*.. When skin ageing, collagen depletion and loss of firmness prove inevitable, skinvestments become non-negotiable.. 2ml sample sachet.. How to use it: In the evening, cleanse your skin, then apply this collagen-boosting night cream to your face and neck. . *Based on consumer study with 120 participants over 3 weeks **Anew Core creams support Collagen longevity and are designed to prolong collagen’s cycle. listings.rawTitle: Wet and Dry Pedi Roller

This much-loved collection of bold colour eyeliners gives you high-impact colour that won’t smudge, flake or fade and lasts all day.†. They’re one of your Avon favourites and now we’re aiming to make them more planet friendly. What’s not to love about that? . We sold almost nine million Glimmersticks across the world last year and they all arrived in a small carton. . We think that’s a waste, so we’re going to trial removing the cartons and issuing your Glimmersticks without packaging. You’ll still get the same great product, minus the unnecessary waste. . Product Specification: • Glide-on colour that lasts all day.† • Intense waterproof formula. • Suitable for sensitive eyes. How to use me: This is our easiest eyeliner ever. Enjoy the soft glide, tug-free application as you make your eyes pop. The best part? No sharpener needed, just twist up for more lasting colour.. †Based on a consumer study with 106 participants..

listings.rawTitle: Glimmerstick Lip Liner Nude
listings.description: About me: . Want to know the secret to fuller lips without the filler? Meet the Glimmerstick Lip Liner that will contour your lips with extra-rich colour to make your lips look extra. Choose from a spectrum of gorgeous shades or try our clear pencil – colourless so you can wear it with all your favourite lipsticks. Product Specification: . • Defines and contours. • Stops lipstick from feathering. • Glides on and wears for hours*. How to use me: . First outline lips, softening edges with fingertips. 2. Then for the fuller look with no filler, create the illusion of fullness with a soft, vertical line from your Cupid’s bow down to the bottom of you lip. 3. Finish with your favourite lip colour, we’re loving our Ultra Matte Lipstick right now. *Based on a consumer study with 32 participants. . Ingredients:. Ingredients: RICINUS COMMUNIS SEED OIL, MICA, CAPRYLIC/CAPRIC TRIGLYCERIDE, CERA MICROCRISTALLINA, C10-18 TRIGLYCERIDES, CERESIN, HYDROGENATED COTTONSEED OIL, TOCOPHEROL, ASCORBYL PALMITATE, SYNTHETIC FLUORPHLOGOPITE, +/-: CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499, CI 15850, CI 77891, CI 77742, CI 45410, CI 45380, CI 75470, CI 42090, CI 19140, CI 15985 <GL 2278>..

listings.rawTitle: Power Stay 24 Hour Longwear Foundation SPF10 115P - Pale Pink
listings.description: All you need to know: . 24 hours* of full coverage and comfort foundation? It’s possible. Our bestselling Power Stay 24H Foundation is now powered with Niacinamide.. It doesn’t block pores, or dry skin and it covers skin redness. This is the liquid foundation that stays put, and stays comfortable, every step of your day.. It stays through heat, humidity and hugs, so your power stays, too.. Why you’ll love it: . STAYS PUT: Colour Lock Technology locks in pigments for lasting wear that stays put through heat, humidity, and non-stop activity.. STAYS COMFORTABLE: breathable, fresh-feel formula now powered with Vitamin B3 Niacinamide.. STAYS MATTE: natural-looking formula evens skin tone and controls the look of shine all day.. SPF10. Oil-free. Non-comedogenic. Dermatologist tested. Choose from 35 shades for all skin tones.. *Based on Consumer Study with 110 participants. . How to use it: . Brush it on. We recommend applying with our Flat Foundation Brush or Full-Coverage Foundation Brush for a pro finish.. Blend it in. Blend the foundation out around your hairline, jawline and neck with our Flat Buffing & Stippling Brush for a seamless finish.. Add concealer if needed. Cover any imperfections that are still showing with Power Stay 18H Longwear Concealer.. . What’s in: . A matte, natural looking medium to full coverage foundation that stays comfortable.. What’s out: . Make-up that melts down. Who has time for that?. . Want to try before you buy? Buy a sample-size here. .
